en.gameDesc: Identify recurrence relations from sequences, solve using characteristic equations, and handle initial conditions. Covers linear homogeneous and inhomogeneous recurrences.

af.gameDesc: Identifiseer rekurrensie-relasies uit reekse, los op met karakteristieke vergelykings, en hanteer aanvanklike voorwaardes. Dek lineêre homogene en nie-homogene rekurrensies.

zu.gameDesc: Khomba ukufana okubuya kusukela ezilundleni, xazulula usebenzisa izilundla zekhiyarekthristiki, uphathise izimo zokuqala. Ihlanganisa ukufana okubuya okulinganayo okufanayo nokungafani.
